Hi Dora! 👋 I was asked to check out your website (www.dora-website.com) and give you feedback. Unfortunately, I ran into a significant issue: the site consistently timed out every time I tried to load it (I tried multiple times, with and without http/https). 

That said, this *is* valuable feedback in itself — it looks like there may be an accessibility or server availability problem. If visitors can't load your site reliably, that could mean lost readers/customers. I'd recommend checking with your hosting provider about uptime and response times, and possibly running a speed/availability test from different locations.

I'd love to give you more detailed design/content feedback once the site is reachable — just let me know when it's back up and I'll take another look!
